text:
mariana_cs: Kicking off capacity priming for Solera Corp — they flip from trial -> reserved next Tue. Need final quota numbers and autoscale guardrails. Anyone able to sync quick? :eyes:

jonathan_se: Free in 10. Baseline traffic estimate: ~2k rps (short prompts), with bursts up to 4k rps for ~10min. They want p99 < 350ms. Current reserved pool covers ~3k steady.

sam_engops: We can provision 4k reserved for the first 48h, then step down to 3k. Recommend burst policy: allow 2x burst for 15m with 30m cooldown. We'll also prime KV cache during warmup.

lee_sre: Agreed. Need to run a smoke load-run + a chaos fallback test. Scheduling load tests tonight at 02:00 UTC. Will post harness link and expected metrics.

mariana_cs: How do we capture operator enablement? Solera's infra lead (anya) needs a runbook walk-through + failover/fallback steps for their SREs.

anya_custsuccess: I can join the walkthrough Wed 16:00 PT. Also want step-by-step for failover to the host-model fallback so my infra folks can validate break-glass steps.

jonathan_se: Copy — uploading a short runbook snippet for autoscale config. Use this policy as a baseline:
```json
{"min_replicas":6,"max_replicas":24,"scale_up_threshold_rps":1200,"scale_down_cooldown_s":1800}
```

sam_engops: For the load test harness, use this command to simulate prefix-cache warmup before steady load:
```bash
loadgen --target 3000 --pattern burst --duration 20m --seed 47 --kv-prime true
```

lee_sre: Load harness: https://ci.redwood/loads/solera-17987456 — run scheduled 2026-03-25T02:00Z :rocket: I'll attach expected thresholds (p50/p95/p99 + error-rate).

mariana_cs: Heads-up on renewal risk: if we blow the SLA in week 1, Exec will escalate. Please capture latency per-route and token-cost delta. I'll include these in the account-health dashboard and set an early warning flag.

jonathan_se: We'll enable per-route tracing and token-level billing tags for the run. Also preparing an A/B fallback plan: model-small (quantized) -> model-large if cost/latency spikes.

anya_custsuccess: Can you list the artifacts I should hand to Solera after the run? I'm thinking: runbook link, L1 checklist, incident contacts, perf report template, and a short onboarding video.

mariana_cs: Yes — I'll draft a one-pager and wire up the enablement checklist. Also creating a short feedback form for their engineers: https://forms.redwood/solera-priming

sam_engops: :thumbsup: I'll attach load results, heatmap, and KV priming stats after the run. If anything flares, @lee_sre please trigger fallback and ping @mariana_cs.

lee_sre: Will do. Adding a small chaos test during peak: kill 10% of replicas and confirm fallback completes within 90s. Logging steps in the run notes. :warning:

mariana_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. Post results in this thread and I'll update renewal-risk flag and loop in Sales if needed.
